notes.title: Train Traffic Manager Now Live! 🚂
notes.content:
The wait is over—Train Traffic Manager is now live on Steam! 

It's time to step into the conductor's seat and take control of the railways. In Train Traffic Manager, you’ll manage complex railway networks, direct traffic lights, switch tracks, and guide trains safely to their destinations—all while avoiding collisions and ensuring everything runs smoothly.

From small, simple networks to sprawling, intricate systems, Train Traffic Manager offers a range of challenging maps that will put your traffic management skills to the test. Each level increases in complexity, pushing you to think quickly and act decisively as trains speed across the tracks.

The railways are yours to manage—are you ready to take charge?

notes.title: Train Traffic Manager arrives September 13th!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share that Train Traffic Manager will launch on September 13th!

From controlling signals to avoiding collisions, Train Traffic Manager puts you in charge of keeping everything running smoothly. Each map will test your skills with increasingly complex rail systems, and every train has its own quirks. It’s all about finding that perfect balance, making smart decisions, and watching the system you’ve built run like clockwork.

[previewyoutube=nAaxQdM1NdY;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re excited for you to experience what we’ve built and can’t wait to see how you master the tracks. Mark your calendar for September 13th and be sure to wishlist Train Traffic Manager so you don’t miss a thing.

notes.title: Train Traffic Manager: Co-op Gameplay Encore
notes.content:
Did you miss our first live stream of Train Traffic Manager? No worries! Here’s your chance to catch the encore of our co-op gameplay session. 

Witness this dynamic duo of our tester navigate through train routes, prevent disasters, and keep the trains running on time. Tune in and be part of the railway adventure once again!

notes.title: Train Traffic Manager: Co-op Chaos
notes.content:
Watch as two of our devs team up to manage the bustling train routes, avoiding collisions and ensuring smooth operations. 

Don’t miss the chance to see how teamwork and quick thinking are essential to mastering the chaos of train traffic management. Mark your calendars and get ready for an unforgettable adventure on the rails!
